rv.q: It's a work of brilliantly sustained deep focus.
“Twilight: Los Angeles, 1992” is a rare thing: the work of an artist at the top of her game, impossible goals impossibly reached.
If learning from the past is possible, Twilight: Los Angeles, 1992 does essential, even lifesaving, work.

cn.t: Smith's powerful documentary play about the LA riots earns strong praise in its ensemble revival, with critics lauding its timely resonance and the cast's ability to shed new light on seminal verbatim material.

vs.sum: A beautifully restored theater with a stunning Tiffany-inspired interior. The 2021 renovation transformed restroom facilities from among Broadway's worst to a model for the industry, with modern bathrooms on every public level.

acc.note: Elevator to Mezzanine, Balcony, and lower level restrooms. 7 wheelchair spaces across all levels.
